newsitem.title: CHINA: IBM signs agreement with Shanghai gov't.
newsitem.headline: IBM signs agreement with Shanghai gov't.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Shanghai city government to jointly develop network computing initiatives for the city, a company official said on Thursday.

At the signing ceremony on Wednesday, IBM's chairman Louis Gerstner said IBM and Shanghai could work together to help the city achieve its goal of becomimg the information network hub of China, the IBM official said.

According to the agreement, IBM would help the city develop and implement network technology projects. One of the initial steps would be the joint establishment of an information technology centre, he said.
IBM and the Shanghai government would set up a coordination team to push forward the projects, he said.
